name: Password Field
description: A password field with a show toggle, and for new passwords a strength meter and the rules it has to meet.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Something to place at the end of the label row, such as a link to reset the password.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon. Defaults to the browser's validation message.

props.name: purpose
props.description: "new" sets autoComplete to new-password and shows the strength meter and the rules. "current" sets current-password and shows neither.

props.name: rules
props.description: The rules listed under a new password. Each one is checked off as the value meets it. Pass an empty list to hide the list.

props.name: strength
props.description: Overrides the built-in estimate, for example with a score from your server. 0 shows an empty meter.

props.name: showStrength
props.description: Shows the four-step strength meter under the field.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: The password, when you control it. Use defaultValue to leave it uncontrolled.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia border and the error message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and its toggle and dims them to 50%.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TextField (name, validate, autoComplete...).

props.name: value
props.description: Returns 0 for an empty value, otherwise 1 (weak) to 4 (strong). An estimate from the length and the kinds of character used, discounting repeats, runs such as abc or qwerty, years and the most common passwords. Anything under 8 characters is weak.
